steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Miss Ela. Are your friends not with you?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Your guards are very interested in Fuze and wouldn't stop asking questions. I left him there since you said you wanted to get them trained up.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: You said there were four of you.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Going by what we agreed on, two of us will protect you while the others continue our search here. They'll be on hand if we need them.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: You're not going out in public today anyway.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Just curious. In fact, it's easier on me with fewer people around.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: I saw you have two top-secret meetings on your schedule.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: I do? What meetings?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Bungee jumping? That's a meeting?

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Of course. Miłosz wouldn't let me do this, but he's not here today. Why not seize the opportunity?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: As your bodyguard... I advise you to rethink this.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: As your employer, I advise you to advise less.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Is my safety harness ready?

steps.name: Staff
steps.text: Yes, sir. You're good to jump anytime.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: See you later.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Yahooo—!

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: What an asshole.

steps.name: Staff
steps.text: Nothing to worry about. Our equipment is first-rate. There's no danger at all.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: You wouldn't have had him sign that waiver if there was no danger.

steps.name: Staff
steps.text: Would you like to come back and remove your safety harness, then?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: On the other hand, my boss did pay for it.
Ela backs up to the edge and feels nothing but air on her heels, a tingling feeling that goes straight up her spine along the harness.
She smiles at the worker and falls backwards, allowing the feeling of weightlessness to seize her heart.
She waits for the rope to become fully stretched, then bounce back, pulling her back up.
Then she hears the sound of a splash in the roaring wind.

steps.name: Staff
steps.text: Oh no, that Vulpo unlocked his own harness?!

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Gówno!

steps.name: Ad
steps.text: Don't get sunburned when you enjoy the beach! Buy Sombrero Dude sunscreen now and get a free set of tail care oil...

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: What is that?

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: That girl with cat ears was handing them out. I took one.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: It's true that UV rays are strong around here.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Not that, this.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: Polishing stone for horns? What are they babbl—

steps.name: Excited Leithanian Tourist
steps.text: Who would have thought there would be such a wonderful vacation spot in war-torn Bolívar? I was dreading this business trip at first.

steps.name: Happy Leithanian Tourist
steps.text: It's been great, except the salt water makes your horns rough. I need to polish mine when we get back to the hotel.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: And conditioner tailored to Vulpo, Lupo and Feline.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Ten-liter set?! I mean, I know they have ears and tails and all...

steps.name: Sneaky Siracusan Tourist.
steps.text: This batch is a good one. Let's talk details on the beach tomorrow.

steps.name: Suspicious Siracusan Tourist
steps.text: They'd better be worth the price.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Okay, they need it.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: Nothing could surprise me now.

steps.name: Sankta Passerby
steps.text: (Frowns disapprovingly)

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: (Goes around scornfully)

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: Sacré dieu...

steps.name: Host
steps.text: Let's welcome our guest today, Mr. Reynell Kowalski, the new star of Dossoles's art scene!

steps.name: Reynell's Voice
steps.text: Thank you, Dossoles TV, for giving me the chance to be scorned by thousands sitting in front of their television screens, and a way for them to let off some steam.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Hey, isn't that the owner of Galería Krysztauowa?

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: I didn't expect to hear his voice on the street.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: I wonder if Ela and Fuze are getting along with him. I have a hunch he's one to get on your nerves.

steps.name: Casino Bouncer
steps.text: If you're not playing, get lost! You're scaring away customers with that shabby outfit.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Street Artist
steps.text: I'm just advertising our community festival. I'm not bothering your guests.

steps.name: Casino Bouncer
steps.text: You'd better not be.

steps.name: Street Artist
steps.text: Hey, folks! Wanna check out our festival? Take a flyer! It's a real special event in the street art community!

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: Thanks, but I don't think we'll have the time...

steps.name: Street Artist
steps.text: You're not going to that glass house opening, are you? Don't let that guy fool you with his fancy talk! He doesn't know anything about art!

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: Er...

steps.name: Street Artist
steps.text: Come on, take a flyer.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: What does it say?

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: Hmm, I would be interested in checking it out, if they manage to pull it off.

steps.name: Reynell's Voice
steps.text: ...This ceremony will stimulate Dossoles's artistic and cultural fields.

steps.name: Reynell's Voice
steps.text: My staff and I have prepared extensive plans for acquisitions, business development, sector growth...

steps.name: Reynell's Voice
steps.text: The opening of Galería Krysztauowa will be a turning point in Dossoles's economic history.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Now I'm more interested in what's on the flyer.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: *Cough* Are you out of your mind, you son of a vixen?!

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Wake up, you bastard!

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Stop playing dead! I can feel your pulse!

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: *Cough* Haha... *cough*

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Just a moment of capriciousness. Releasing the shackles that bind me at the closest point to the surface, and falling freely into the water...

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Isn't that so much more fun than just bouncing up and down on a rope?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: ...I'm sorry, Mr. Reynell, but I don't think I can continue to serve as your bodyguard. Thank you for giving us a place to stay. My squad and I will move out tomorrow.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Come on, I've fallen into water from even greater heights. See, I'm completely fine, am I not? No need to get angry.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: I can't protect a man who plays jokes with his life.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: You're mistaken, Miss Ela. I have a goal that I've been working toward for many years. Until it's complete, no one values his life more than I do.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Remember to wipe yourself dry. I can tell your constitution is not as strong as 'ours.'

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Don't you know? Once you step through this door, it's not up to you whether you get to step back through it again.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: I come in good faith, Capitán Mateo.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Good faith? After the reception my men got from your boss?

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: Why can't you and Reynell stop bickering with one another?

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Interesting question. Is he going to hand over the plot of land where that street art community is squatting?

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Get in my way, and you get in the way of Bolívar's Coalition government.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: A Kazimierzian with nothing but money thinks he can negotiate with a government representative just because he hired a few mercenaries?

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: Reynell doesn't want to fight you over that piece of land. If we can reach an agreement, he is happy to cede control of the land to you... or to the Coalition government. It makes no difference.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: And you speak for him?

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: I do.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: We could have been talking about this under more amicable circumstances, if not for that ill-conceived kidnapping attempt.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: You blame me for that?

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: It was an unfortunate misunderstanding.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: No need to make excuses for me. I don't care. Just tell me, what does Reynell want?

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: One doesn't do business in Bolívar for long without the support of a powerful patron... someone like you.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: I spent most of my years in the army, not the classroom. Get to the point.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: Well... that neighborhood is not so much a home for artists as a lawless place where gangs roam unchecked.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: We had plans for its development, but the residents were utterly vicious. Even worse, there are Infected living among them.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Hmph. You thought money could solve all your problems in Dossoles.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: Yes. Only those who are can solve problems get to enjoy the ultimate fruit.

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: I don't know your style or skills, so I think the quickest way would be a simulated engagement.

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: Two teams, four in each team, best of three.

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: Attacking team tries to locate the hostage and rescue him, defending team tries to stop the attackers from rescuing the hostage.

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: Any questions?

steps.name: Talkative Guard
steps.text: Who's the hostage?

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: For the sake of fairness, me.

steps.name: Guard Attacker A
steps.text: I'm in through the window!

steps.name: Guard Attacker A
steps.text: Room's empty! Moving on to the next one.

steps.name: Guard Attacker B
steps.text: Hey, watch where you're going!

steps.name: Guard Attacker A
steps.text: You watch where you're going!

steps.name: Guard Attacker B
steps.text: Quiet! I've already searched the direction you're going in. There's nobody there. Didn't you hear it on the radio?

steps.name: Guard Attacker A
steps.text: Radio? Oh, I dropped my earpiece out the window. I was looking for you to get a new one.

steps.name: Guard Defender A
steps.text: Two enemies down. I could hear them from a mile away.

steps.name: Guard Defender B
steps.text: How about you crouch behind this board? Maybe show an inch or two of your head, so as to draw their attention.

steps.name: Guard Defender C
steps.text: The three of us will guard the only door and take them out as they enter.

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: ...You're not concerned that I could get hurt?

steps.name: Guard Defender D
steps.text: Get hurt? Nah, we got them the moment they step inside.

steps.name: Guard Defender B
steps.text: Dammit! The Originium Arts! I can't see!

steps.name: Guard Defender C
steps.text: Th-They're coming in through the window! Stay back!

steps.name: Guard Attacker C
steps.text: Hostage found. There were three idiots waiting by the door. Looks like they forgot there's more than one way in.

steps.name: Guard Attacker D
steps.text: The bright flash looks like it works well... hey, what's that guy doing?

steps.name: Guard Defender C
steps.text: Get away from me! Dammit! Get away!

steps.name: Guard Attacker C
steps.text: H-He's just shooting blindly! Where are my teammates? All down?!

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: *Russian swearing*. Stop, stop!

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: You guys are a real eye-opener.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: You're back early. I thought you would be out enjoying places I don't let you go.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: There was an accident.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: You're hurt?

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: No, Miss Ela quit.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: ...This is the 32nd bodyguard who's had enough of you. I can't spend all day with you when I've got my own job to do.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: What about your negotiations with the Capitán?

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: He took the bait.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Good. Now we'll see how our 'friends' in that community perform.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: He'll have his hands full.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: I've spent long enough dealing with those artists to know that if there's one thing they do well, it's causing trouble.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Miss Ela! Have you handed in your resignation papers yet?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: No one told me HR is closed today.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Ah, my staff have always been capricious. It's such a headache.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Before I go, you should know that the sculpture at the center of the special exhibit is a counterfeit.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: It's a tiny bit different from the other works by the same sculptor. You should look into it.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Maybe your dealer ripped you off. I guess that's a fact of life for a businessman like you.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Hahaha! I'm starting to regret letting you go, Miss Ela.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Oh yeah?

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: You have a good eye. I was the one who made the counterfeit. I kind of liked it, so I just left it out.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: It's been there for a while. You're the first one to realize it's a fake.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Maybe others just don't dare point it out.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Since that doesn't bother you, my friends and I will be going now.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Just a moment, Miss Ela.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Would you keep working for me if I promised to behave?

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: (Mumble) Well, that's something you don't see every day...

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: You're trying to persuade me to stay?

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Don't you want to see the authentic piece? You must have spent a lot of time with that sculptor's work to notice such tiny details.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: I hope you can keep your promise.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: How far to Dossoles, Ernesto?

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: We're almost there.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: You've been saying that for days!

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: Yes, we're almost there... once I deliver this batch of medicine, I'll take you to a sunny beach where you can lie down for a whole day.

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: Far away from any casinos or bars.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: I could live with bars. I understand that some people need to drink their troubles away... hey, how did you know I don't like casinos?

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: It's my first time taking a partner operator home to Dossoles, so I asked Orchid about you before we left.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Then you know what happened when I left my homeland...

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: A brave act.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: And when I went back...

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: An honorable choice.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Well, it's not something I'm ashamed of... it's just a little more fit to be shared over a drink or two, not like this...

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Well, you can buy me a drink when we get to Dossoles. That's my price for hearing the story. Deal?

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: Deal.
